original_benchmark.notes: RecreationBench Web: 50 reference sites, scored by hidden Playwright tests (Prog) and VLM-judged visual assertions (VLM).
50 tasks per platform. They need OS virtual machines or an Android emulator with GUI automation and are not adapted.

harbor_adapter.parity_costs: About $100 (estimate): roughly 98M input tokens per side over 3 runs of 10 tasks, plus judge calls
harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a seeded, difficulty-stratified 10-task subset (3 easy, 3 medium, 4 hard), 3 runs per side.
